_doc: Forge switch catalog (modernization WP I.2): every switch, skill, check, tool and workflow Forge can turn on for a task, with the mission conditions that call for it and its safety class. Read ONLY through .claude/forge-bin/forge-anticipate.cjs (plan / apply / revert / explain / metric / validate). Owner rule (docs/claude-md/intelligence-bar.md rule 1): work out what a task needs and use every SAFE item without being asked; OWNER-GATED items (cost, outbound, credentials, destructive, production) wait in the owner queue, batched at the end of the run. Classification is conservative and cross-checked by validate: a SAFE entry may not trip the hard-gate classifier (forge-actiongate.cjs classify() on how_to_enable), may not point at a config key with a disclosure flag (C N $ U X D) and may not use a risk word (push, send, token, delete, quota, production ...). Every entry names a real mechanism that validate opens (schema key, skill folder, tool file, hard rule, gate id, locked id); evidence_ref refs: a standing-rule ref must name a rule in the SHIPPED FORGE_STANDING_RULES.json, in every install; an owner-rule ref cites the Forge maintainer's own owner overlay (FORGE_STANDING_RULES.user.json of the development tree, never shipped) and is checked strictly only in the development tree (.claude/config/forge-dev-tree.json) and noted elsewhere, because a synced project's overlay holds that project owner's own rules (found 2026-11-02 when a synced project with its own overlay turned validate red); evidence-row refs read docs/audit/intelligence-evidence.md (local-only): checked where the file exists, noted where it does not. Fields: id, kind (config-key|skill|check|tool|workflow), label {en,nl}, how_to_enable (exact command or mechanism), scope (run|session|project), reversible, revert, class (SAFE|OWNER-GATED), class_reason (list of cost|outbound|credentials|destructive|production|none), triggers (any trigger object may match; the keys inside one object must all hold), announce {en,nl}, evidence (pointer) + evidence_ref, default_state (on|off|config: then config_key + on_values [+ ask_values] decide it live), optional requires_config, enforcement {status mechanical|partial|prose-only, by, gap}, verify (runtime:true refs must exist for the entry to be used), caveat, pre_authorized_by, evidence_row/evidence_class (the twelve owner requests of docs/audit/intelligence-evidence.md section 1). Keywords (signals and triggers, WP I.8b) match through the shared NL/EN normaliser forge-text-normalize.cjs: a word also matches its plurals and its -ing form (wachtwoord -> wachtwoorden, parse -> parses/parsing; never -er/-ed: platform is not platformer), a phrase matches word by word (role-based -> role based), 'word*' = starts with, '-word' = also as the END of a Dutch compound (beheerderswachtwoord), 'word-' = also as the START (inlog- -> inlogflow), '-word-' = both; a compound marker needs one word of 5+ letters and is used only where the look-alikes were checked (sessie stays whole-word: trainingssessie is not a login session). A signal may add exclude {en,nl} (phrases blanked before its keywords are tested: git checkout, coaching session) and together [{a:{en,nl}, b:{en,nl}}] (a hit needs a word from a AND one from b: app + people can).
